key_phrases: revenue performance will decelerate during the December quarter
installed base of active devices continue to grow nicely
we are working very hard to fulfill the demand
analysis.reasoning: The overall sentiment is cautiously optimistic; while the company achieved record revenues, management provided a clear warning of deceleration in the upcoming December quarter due to macroeconomic headwinds and foreign exchange (FX) volatility. Confidence remains high, particularly regarding the strength of the installed base and product demand (iPhone 14 Pro constraints), though guidance is intentionally vague to manage expectations. The company shows strong pricing power and a robust competitive moat, evidenced by record-breaking services growth and high customer satisfaction. Quantitative specificity is very high, with detailed breakdowns of revenue by segment and FX impact. The slight negative forward guidance tone is primarily driven by the transition from a high-growth period and significant FX headwinds rather than fundamental demand weakness.
